name: Fort Yargo State Park
evidence: Wayback 2024-03 leaf-off z19 near 33.9686,-83.7238 (second read): two RVs ~20-22 m from the inlet shore behind a tree band with evergreens; matches Campground #1 sites 9-12 on the 2024 park map (not to scale, numbers inferred); sites 4-8 ~26-33 m back in pines. Full canopy leaf-on, so lakefront not earned: a leaf-off view. Yurts, walk-ins, cottages excluded.

name: Gatewood Park
evidence: Wayback 2024-03 z19 at 34.1668,-84.7248 (gwz3): RV on the south tip loop ~25-30 m from the rock high-water edge across open unused ground; county 2025 map puts sites 25-28 here (26-27 by inference; 28 is 20 ft, excluded). WebTrac WF tags are a lead only; other loops are canopy-blind. Lake side of Allatoona Dam.

name: Georgia Veterans Memorial State Park
evidence: Esri (31.9505,-83.9155 and -83.9125; ~0.29 m/px): parked RVs ~12-18 m from shore on open grass with scattered trees, no continuous screen. Operator page ('lakeside sites') and engine 'Water Front' tag are leads only. No dam near.

name: Holiday Campground
evidence: rec.gov 232606 catalog: 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on many RV-bookable electric sites 23 ft+ (e.g. 36-37, 48-49); prior 'no per-site flag' was wrong. Leaf-off Esri (33.0158,-85.1965): 36/37 ~20-30 m and 48/49 ~25-30 m from high-water edge, open ground. Old pin at a building ~375 m from nearest RV site.

name: High Falls State Park River Campground
evidence: Esri at pin and prior Wayback 2020 leaf-off: river-side sites 25-60 m behind a wooded band dropping ~10 m to the Towaliga; visible loop 100+ m from river. Below the dam (167 m vs ~177 m pool), so no lake value. No new counting evidence this pass.

name: Lake Tobesofkee Claystone Park
evidence: Macon-Bibb ArcGIS camping layer plots sites 40-45 ('RV WF'); Esri (32.8294,-83.7800, 50 m=188 px): nearest site 43 ~45-50 m from shore across the loop road and open slope with docks. Road crosses the apron, so open view only. 'WF' tag is a lead. Prior 'continuous tree fringe' wording was wrong.

name: Lawrence Shoals Campground
evidence: Georgia Power Lakes page unit coordinates plotted on Esri (33.3540,-83.1715; 50 m=81 px): 'Waterfront'-tagged sites 6, 12, 13, 15, 17 all ~75-120 m from shore under continuous canopy. Private-operator tag is a lead and imagery contradicts it.

name: Lock & Dam Park (Coosa River Campground)
evidence: Rome-Floyd rate sheet ('On the Coosa River', sites 1-6, 9) is a lead; official park map (200-ft scale) and Esri (34.1990,-85.2552; 50 m=180 px): pads ~33-39 m from water behind a road-side trail and continuous bank tree band. Upstream side of the lock dam, so no below-dam issue.
